metadata.task_category: Graph Theory - Tree / All-Pairs Brute Force

prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the HackerRank problem Ticket to Ride.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution computes all-pairs distances O(n^2) and then evaluates all pairs (u,v) with all tickets O(n^2 * m), which is infeasible.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Brute-force approach ignoring tree properties and efficient path aggregation techniques.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Nested loops over u, v, and tickets
